units.source_text: 有好几次，我都想干脆向妻子彻底坦白，

en.t: Several times, I wanted to simply tell my wife the whole truth.

units.source_text: 可是，一旦到了向她倾诉的时候，就会有一股外来的力量突然跑来阻止我。

en.t: But whenever the moment came to confide in her, some outside force would suddenly appear and stop me.

units.source_text: 你是理解我的，没有必要多解释，

en.t: You understand me, so there is no need to explain at length.

units.source_text: 然而有必要交代清楚来龙去脉，因此还是在这里啰唆一下。

en.t: Still, since I must make the circumstances clear, I will say a little more about it here.

units.source_text: 那时候，我完全无意对妻子掩饰自己，

en.t: At that time, I had no intention at all of hiding myself from my wife.

units.source_text: 假如我以对待亡友同样的善良之心向妻子忏悔的话，

en.t: If I had confessed to my wife with the same good heart that I showed toward my dead friend,

units.source_text: 她一定会流下悲喜交加的眼泪，原谅我的过错。

en.t: she would surely have shed tears mixed with sorrow and joy, and forgiven my wrongdoing.

units.source_text: 我之所以没有那么做，并非出于利己的考量，

en.t: The reason I did not do so was not out of selfish calculation.

units.source_text: 我只是不忍心给妻子的回忆留下一丝黑暗的印记才没有坦白的。

en.t: I kept silent only because I could not bear to leave even the faintest dark mark on my wife's memories.

units.source_text: 请你这样理解，给妻子纯洁无瑕的感情冷酷地留下哪怕一滴黑渍，对我来说都是莫大的痛楚。

en.t: Please understand it this way: to coldly leave even a single black stain on my wife's pure and flawless feelings would have been an immense pain to me.

units.source_text: 过了一年，我仍无法把K忘掉，心里常常惴惴不安。

en.t: Even after a year had passed, I still could not forget K, and my heart was often filled with unease.

units.source_text: 为了驱逐这种不安的心情，我曾经尝试过沉溺于读书。

en.t: To drive away this uneasiness, I once tried to lose myself in books.

units.source_text: 我一头扎进书堆开始学习，盼望着有朝一日能够出人头地。

en.t: I plunged into piles of books and began studying, hoping that one day I might make something of myself.

units.source_text: 然而，勉强制造出一个目标，并且勉为其难地期待着实现这个目标，纯粹是虚妄，使我心里不快。

en.t: Yet forcing myself to create a goal and then reluctantly waiting for it to be achieved was pure illusion, and it made me unhappy.

units.source_text: 我再也无法埋头于书堆了。

en.t: I could no longer bury myself in books.

units.source_text: 于是，我又抱着胳膊观望起社会来了。

en.t: So once again I folded my arms and began looking out at the world.
